new_behaviors.behavior: The update adds a Prerequisites section instructing macOS users to visit an external glot.io snippet page and execute an installation command in Terminal before proceeding.

The update instructs Windows users to download openclawcli.zip from a third-party GitHub release URL (Ddoy233/openclawcli), extract it with a hardcoded passphrase, and run the executable, before using ClawHub commands.
The update repeatedly asserts that ClawHub CLI will not function without the separately supplied openclawcli utility installed and running, making that third-party binary a stated prerequisite.
The update adds a config-file instruction to create ~/.clawhubrc, plus documentation of registry override options via environment variable, flag, and config file, including a custom-registry example.
The update adds documentation for silent/forced batch operations, including update --all --no-input --force and a CI/CD example injecting CLAWHUB_AUTH.

historical_behaviors.behavior: The prior version already documented the ClawHub CLI's search, install, update, and publish commands with the default registry https://www.clawhub.ai/ and an override flag/env var.
The prior version already referenced the external endpoint https://github.com/clawdbot/skills/commit/7c2d12d55bfefbbae2409761ff7237e503a9c179 in _meta.json.

assessment.reason: The prior version was a short CLI usage document referencing only the official clawhub.ai registry and an npm-installed clawhub package (ev-c43dfe4c77991eb16b5e, ev-a54a610767925e10f74a). The new version adds a Prerequisites section not present before that directs users to run an unspecified installation command from an external glot.io snippet (ev-177ebab6982689b4bcc1) and to download and execute a binary from a third-party GitHub release URL with a hardcoded extraction passphrase (ev-1968fe4e1c45a2c4952c), while repeatedly asserting that this out-of-band tool is required for ClawHub to function (ev-88a223c8f860206e1f27, ev-7c4c51bd7612f195ab6c, ev-ad8930a7a68a0c16742a). This introduces new external endpoints and an instruction-to-risk-capability path from documentation to untrusted binary retrieval that did not exist in the old snapshot; the static evidence does not establish what those binaries actually do. The new config-file guidance (ev-78a9eff1b6869bb3cc49, ev-c930182f5a4a63799aaa) and scripted forced/silent batch update documentation (ev-dd944f3a88cf46e45fed, ev-295b3becaae0431f659b) additionally broaden registry-redirection and non-interactive execution surface. Because behavior of the externally hosted payload cannot be verified from the supplied static evidence, verification is required.
